description: This Swift source file defines data models related to gateway usage tracking, including structures for usage windows, providers, summaries, and UI presentation logic such as usage rows and formatting functions. It also includes an asynchronous loader for fetching usage summaries from a control channel.

classes.name: GatewayUsageWindow
classes.description: Represents a usage window with label, usage percentage, and optional reset time.

classes.name: GatewayUsageProvider
classes.description: Represents a provider with display details, associated usage windows, and optional plan or error info.

classes.name: GatewayUsageSummary
classes.description: Encapsulates overall usage data including update timestamp and list of providers; provides method to generate primary usage rows.

classes.name: UsageRow
classes.description: Represents a UI data model for displaying usage information, including computed properties and formatting logic.

classes.name: UsageLoader
classes.description: Static async class responsible for loading usage summary data from an external source via ControlChannel.

methods.name: primaryRows
methods.description: Generates a list of UsageRow objects based on the providers and their usage windows.

methods.name: detailText
methods.description: Returns a detailed string about remaining usage, window label, and reset time.

methods.name: formatResetRemaining
methods.description: Private static method to format time remaining until reset in human-readable form.

methods.name: loadSummary
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches and decodes the usage summary from the ControlChannel.
